feedback: Iteration 0 has no race telemetry, so this review rests only on the contract and the candidate's own contents. The candidate is valid: five sensors within the position limits, five weights within [-2, 2], base_speed 1.6 and kp 2.0 inside their ranges, and the sign convention matches the contract (positive weights on left-side sensors steer left). The sensor pitch of 12 mm with 8 mm footprints covers the 25 mm tape with overlap. Nothing in the candidate looks obviously broken, and no earlier race exists to show it is worse than anything else. Its main untested risks are on the slalom and sharp bends, where kd 0.1 may be too little damping and base_speed 1.6 may be too high for the turns. Those risks can only be settled by racing. Next revision, if the race shows line loss or steering oscillation: raise kd, or lower base_speed. If the race shows completion with high rms_error on the bends: raise kp slightly. If the race shows completion_time well under 3 s with low rms_error: keep the controller and test the geometry only if a later iteration needs more margin.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events or max_error spike on the slalom or sharp bends: lower controller.base_speed (for example 1.6 to 1.2) and raise controller.kd (for example 0.1 to 0.3), keeping the other fields as they are.
If steering_oscillation is high while completion is good: raise controller.kd only, in steps of about 0.1, and leave kp unchanged.
If completion is reached but completion_time is near 3 s with low rms_error: raise controller.base_speed (for example 1.6 to 1.8) before changing any gain.
